stages.S1: Bundle-of-ten TB1: Mrs Binta leads four seated children at the blackboard. John path puzzle needs twenty paper markers; children must pack exactly the right number.
stages.S2: TB1: We will make tens and ones, then count, read and write through twenty. Board hint Make a bundle. Count the ones. uses words before the new numeral.
stages.S3: TB2 demonstrates ten loose ones tied as one ten and opened/recounted with quantity unchanged. TB3 models tens left/ones right using fourteen; TB4-5 model every quantity/name from eleven through twenty. TB6 live formation/reading models twelve and twenty, then all 10-20.
stages.S4: TB2-6/WB1,3: count, bundle and unbundle real ten; guided thirteen; each eleven-to-twenty model built before advancing. Live writing, air-writing, tracing, covering and trying again. All four children contribute checking, explanation and materials.
stages.S5: TB7-8/WB2,4: Q1 twelve, Q2 sixteen as one ten/six ones, Q3 ten ones, Q4 missing nineteen, Q5 show twenty with two verified real tens, Q6 distinguish ten ones from one one. Exact needed diagrams local; textbook uses exercise book.
